item.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu and Ministers Ben Gvir and Eliyahu present details of the operation to locate the Altalena and the findings that were discovered.

item.title: Haredi extremists protest, Geha Interchange blocked
item.description: Extremists blocked the Geha Interchange, in the Petah Tikva and Bnei Brak area, as well as Jabotinsky Street, which separates the two cities, in protest against the arrest of a Haredi draft dodger.

item.title: ‘They beat and kicked me’: Reservist recounts detention by PA Forces
item.description: IDF reservist says PA officers beat him, sprayed him with pepper spray, seized his weapon and took him handcuffed into Ramallah after stopping his car in Area C.

item.title: Netanyahu and Katz presented with data showing decline in terrorism
item.description: The Prime Minister and Defense Minister held a situational assessment at Central Command. Minister Katz: “The number of terrorist attacks in Judea and Samaria has fallen to levels we have never seen before."

item.title: Why Omer Adam’s wedding will have separate seating for men and women
item.description: Omer Adam and Sacha Israelovich’s lavish wedding in Italy will reportedly feature separate seating for men and women due to a condition set by haredi singer Motty Steinmetz.

item.title: In three months | 13 kilometers of terror tunnels destroyed in Gaza
item.description: Paratroopers Brigade troops completed their defensive and infrastructure-clearing missions along the “Yellow Line." The tunnel in which the late Lt. Hadar Goldin was held was also destroyed.

item.title: Iranian threat against Trump’s son
item.description: An Iranian state-run television channel aired a video threatening President Trump’s youngest son and claimed that details of his security arrangements had been exposed.

item.description: Another kite sent from Gaza was found on a tree in Kibbutz Nahal Oz.

item.title: PM holds security assessment at Central Command
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a security assessment today at IDF Central Command regarding the security challenges in the Judea and Samaria region.
Taking part in the discussion were the Minister of Defense, Chief of the General Staff, Head of the National Security Council, Commander of IDF Central Command, Head of the IDF Intelligence Directorate, Head of the IDF Operations Directorate, Commander of the Judea and Samaria Division, and other senior officials.

item.title: ‘Hamas stops at nothing’: Drugs found hidden in Gaza aid supplies
item.description: World Central Kitchen staff discover 600 grams of hashish and 162 grams of illicit substances hidden inside humanitarian aid supplies in Gaza.

item.title: Authorities demolish structures at sacred Honi Hame’agel gravesite
item.description: Authorities demolish unauthorized structures at Honi Hame’agel’s gravesite in Hatzor Haglilit as part of efforts to improve safety and develop the site.

item.title: Nightmare on Arkia flight
item.description: An Arkia flight from Podgorica to Israel was delayed after the aircraft was diverted to Tirana. Passengers were transported by bus to Albania, and about 50 of them were forced to spend the night there.

item.title: Trump: 'Iran is completely collapsing'
item.description: US President says Iran is "completely collapsing" in social media post.

item.title: Tax Authority tightens rules for haredi yeshivas over draft status
item.description: New requirements expand a policy previously applied only to new institutions, potentially affecting haredi yeshivas across Israel.

item.title: Chabad rabbis sound alarm over construction at ancient Hebron cemetery
item.description: Urgent petition warns construction and earthworks at the historic Chabad cemetery could damage graves and ancient burial caves.

item.title: IDF officer injured in accidental shooting at military base
item.description: IDF officer moderately injured by accidental gunfire at Combat Engineering School in the Arava; Military Police launch investigation.

item.title: IDF takes out October 7 Nukhba terrorists plotting new attacks
item.description: Hamas terrorists who participated in the October 7 massacre, planned new attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians, are eliminated in Gaza.

item.title: Hymanut Kassaou's parents to Shin Bet chief: Take over the case
item.description: After 911 days without answers, Hymanut Kassaou's parents urge Shin Bet Director David Zini to take over the investigation.

item.title: Caught in the act: Three suspects arrested for breaking into vehicles in Hadera
item.description:
Three residents of Ramla were arrested on suspicion of breaking into vehicles and stealing tools at the Mool HaYam Village complex in Hadera.
Police said the suspects were located during a targeted operation. Numerous tools suspected of being stolen were found in their vehicle.
The investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Dozens of Israeli police officers to secure Uman pilgrimage
item.description: More than 40 Israeli police officers to be deployed in Ukraine, Romania, and key transit points as tens of thousands of Breslov hasidim make their way to Uman for the Jewish New Year.

item.title: Netanyahu warns of splintering parties on the right
item.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu urges right-wing voters not to support parties failing to pass the electoral threshold: 'You are wasting your vote. It guarantees the rise of the left, which would be a disaster for Israel.'

item.title: After 78 years beneath the sea: Altalena found intact
item.description: Historic ship at center of one of Israel's most painful early confrontations is located at a depth of 503 meters after months of searching.

item.title: CoS to special forces: Operations you carried out will be written in the pages of history
item.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir to special forces troops at Palmachim Air Force Base, 'Your unprecedented operations required courage, imagination and skill; and most cannot be discussed publicly.'

item.title: Katz warns Hamas over Gaza kites: 'Zero tolerance'
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns Israel will respond forcefully after four kites found in Israeli territory. 'One law for balloons, kites, and drones.'

item.title: Ben Gvir scores victory over AG: 'She failed again'
item.description: Justice Noam Sohlberg rejects bid to bar National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir from speaking at event honoring civilian security squads, overruling Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara.

item.title: China hosts robots from 16 countries for 'Robot Olympics' in Beijing
item.description: The competition between humans and machines turned into a genuine showdown, when a robot broke legendary sprinter Usain Bolt’s historic 100-meter record. Watch.
